page.overview:
What is Burning Eyes?

The Burning Eyes, formally referred to as the Ofanim and the Ofanim Court, and sometimes as the "Many-eyed" and the "Angel's Shame," were members of the Order of the First Sphere of the ancient Blood Angels Legion during the Great Crusade and Horus Heresy. The Burning Eyes no longer exist in the Blood Angels Chapter of the 41st Millennium.

The First Sphere Order of the Ofanim were entrusted by their primarch Sanguinius with the very integrity of the Legion itself and few were beyond the reach of their jurisdiction. Such was their overarching authority, an Ofanim Court could supplant themselves directly into the chain of command, free to act of their own volition thereof. It was, however, viewed as an ominous portent should any Blood Angels commander cause the eye of the Ofanim to turn to him in this manner.

This specialist formation was under writ of the Great Angel himself to punish treachery wherever it was to be found in the IX Legion. In the wake of the treachery of the Warmaster Horus during the Horus Heresy, the Ofanim were called upon with greater frequency. While the members of the Ofanim were expert bladesmen, it was in single combat, against their transhuman brethren, where their true skill came to the fore.

This dark brotherhood sought out the champions among the ranks of the foe, the greatest of the Traitor primarchs' gene-sons, and tested the strength of their treacherous conviction in single combat -- only to find them wanting -- leaving the Traitors' pride in the dust.
